title: World Championship Decks 2000: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Part prison, part home.
"At this rate I fully expect to be replaced by a clockwork golem by year's end." —Barrin
Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.
The helix was the finest example of Mishra's campaign strategy: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.
The key did not work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.
Rising waters, sinking hope.
"I wonder how it feels to be bored." —Jhoira, artificer
The most effective way to destroy a spell is to ensure it was never cast in the first place.
"Temper, temper" —Ertai, wizard adept
"I see more than others do because I know where to look." —Saprazzan vizier
To renew the land, plow the land. To destroy the land, do nothing. —Druids' saying
"The fishers will throw out their nets and draw them back filled with dust." —Oracle *en*-Vec
Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.
"Mold could catch you." —Suq'Ata insult
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?" —Rana, Suq'Ata market fool
Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.
Rishada is the gateway to free trade—but the key will cost you.
"My people are bound by masters centuries dead. Each artifact we destroy is another link broken in that chain." —Barb Tail, viashino heretic
"We've managed to keep the goblins in their assigned areas, but there's little we can do about the smell." —Whip Tongue, viashino technician
Fire never dies alone.
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows." —Seal inscription
"I do not teach. I simply reveal." —Daudi, Femeref tutor
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot. —Llanowar penalty for trespassing
Life is eternal. A lifetime is ephemeral.
The Brothers' War scarred the land, but Ashnod left her mark in the bloodlines of those she tortured.
Ramos bled, and there was fire.
When the mighty sleep, the lowly prowl.
"I do not miss sunlight. The very memory of it burns my eyes." —Volrath
The strength of law is unwavering. It is an iron bar in a world of water.
Jamuraa's rhystic mages treat magic as their garden, uprooting unwanted spells as bothersome weeds.
"Uh, does anyone have a flute?" —Rana, Suq'Ata market fool
To hone swords and dull minds. —Whetstone inscription
If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.
Living metal encasing dying flesh.
"Believe in the ideal, not the idol." —Serra
"I don't understand why he works so hard on a device to duplicate a sound so easily made with hand and armpit." —Barrin, progress report
He craves only one commodity.
Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.
Treasures, trinkets, trash—the relics of the past are brought forth again.
Pass me from soul to soul, / soldier to herder, herder to beast, beast to soil / until I am everywhere. / Then pass me those souls. —Totem inscription (translated)
Motivation was high in the academy once students realized flunking their exams could kill them.
"I am the unraveler, the loosened thread that will not hold." —Seal inscription
"Temper, temper." —Ertai, wizard adept
"The solution can hide for only so long." —Urza
Perception is more pleasing than truth.
"To the tutors, a 'poem of sand' was of little account, a 'poem of ivory,' priceless." —Afari, *Tales*
